scope: Twelve held-out new-seed analytic motion probes: controlled latent mechanism recovery, not expert observable-motion or field generalization. Method frozen after pilot-v3; all observations/errors in this probe family are newly generated. Same recalibrated numeric baselines and stage head for every visual activity arm.
stage_policy: Newly trained XGBoost stage head on the common train split; no old fitted model. Same head and support on all visual activity arms; native numeric heads also scored.
freeze: Keep policy, feedback, rendering, aggregation, model settings unchanged from pilot-v3. Record predictions before test scoring; never tune or resample the twelve test records.
primary: Activity P/R/F1, FP/FN, weak scenario recall, event matching and boundary errors
secondary: End-to-end A/S/D and false A, coverage, output failures, requests/tokens/time
interpretation: Do not promote independent synthetic mechanism recovery to independent field or expert observable-label validation. Existing previously sealed background test remains untouched. No positive effect is presumed.
